items.title: U.S. presses China on Mastercard, Citigroup market access in bilateral Bangkok talks, official says
items.summary: BANGKOK – U.S. officials pressed Beijing on market access issues for Mastercard Inc and Citigroup Inc during at least two bilateral meetings with Chinese counterparts in Bangkok this week, according to a U.S. Treasury official.

items.title: People in China are spending nearly as much of their income as Americans on healthcare
items.summary: BEIJING — High healthcare costs are a big factor driving people in China to save, rather than spend, their money, the International Monetary Fund pointed out in a new book titled "Toward a New Economic Growth Model for China."

items.title: Harvard’s endowment jumps 27% in fiscal 2026, lifted by SpaceX as top holding
items.summary: Harvard University's endowment grew 27.1% in fiscal year 2026, its strongest return in five years, the school said in its annual financial report released on Thursday.

items.title: U.S. budget deficit swells to almost $2 trillion for fiscal 2026, up 12% in a single year
items.summary: The U.S. finished the 2026 fiscal year with a budget deficit of nearly $2 trillion, the latest measurement to underscore the extent of the country's financial stress.

items.title: Analysis: Everyone expects the Fed to hold rates in October. Kevin Warsh could surprise us all
items.summary: Traders are betting overwhelmingly that the Federal Reserve won't raise interest rates when it meets later this month.

items.title: Analysis: Why a $2 trillion deficit and 5% Treasury yields are becoming America's biggest economic challenge
items.summary: Long-term bond yields above 5% and a $2 trillion deficit are giving Americans a taste of what a U.S. debt crisis would be like.
